Drishyam 3 Trailer Released, Ajay Devgn Returns

The trailer for 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' has been released, featuring Ajay Devgn reprising his role as Vijay Salgaonkar. The trailer also introduces Jaideep Ahlawat, who appears poised to challenge Devgn's character. The film is a continuation of the 'Drishyam' franchise, with reports indicating discussions about a potential fourth part, drawing parallels to Mohanlal's Malayalam version of the series.
